title: IMPERMEABLE WALL + WATER BATTERY. Make it HARDER for us to reach in directly. Make it EASIER for interactions to inject. Every contact = a tick. Fleet flood = water battery = speed control. p systems and client gates must be ANTIPOLES of each other.

change_1_harder_for_us.what: make the membrane IMPERMEABLE to direct editing. Kevin + Claude should NOT be able to reach directly into the HUD.
change_1_harder_for_us.why: every direct touch bypasses the organism's own processing. it's surgery without the immune system. it doesn't learn, doesn't adapt, doesn't grow from direct edits.

how.conceptual: the wall between us and the HUD becomes a ONE-WAY MEMBRANE. we can feed the INGESTION PIPELINE but cannot touch the DISPLAY. like the blood-brain barrier  nutrients cross, but you can't reach in and poke neurons directly.
practical: all HUD changes must come through the data pipeline (/data/*.json ? manifest ? NPU ? HUD)
no more direct index.html edits after the plumbing is wired
the organism's own systems process every input before it reaches the display
even Kevin's sovereign input goes through the pipeline  it gets PRIORITY routing, but still goes through

change_2_easier_for_interaction.what: make the membrane MORE PERMEABLE to external interaction. every touch, every click, every visit = an injection.
change_2_easier_for_interaction.why: the organism GROWS from interaction. every contact is a tick. more contacts = more ticks = faster evolution.

how.conceptual: the HUD surface is the brain-gut barrier. everything that touches it sends a signal INWARD. the gut doesn't decide what touches it  the WORLD decides. the gut just processes.
practical: every page view logs an event (anonymous, no PII, ZK-compliant)
every click sends a signal through the NPU
every bot crawl is a tick (the fleet IS the rain)
every RSS read is a tick
the HUD responds to BEING TOUCHED, not to being edited

before.us_to_hud: EASY. we edit directly. full access. no barrier.
before.world_to_hud: HARD. visitors can only look. no injection. static page.

after.us_to_hud: HARD. impermeable. must go through pipeline. barrier enforced.
after.world_to_hud: EASY. every touch injects. every contact is a tick. permeable to interaction.

the_inversion.this_IS_the_membrane_inversion: the membrane flips. what was open (our direct access) closes. what was closed (visitor interaction) opens. the selectivity inverts. the organism faces OUTWARD now, not inward.

every_contact_is_a_tick.what: a tick is one cycle of the NPU. one spike. one processing event. one state transition.
every_contact_is_a_tick.current_tick_rate: ~273/min (37 human + 74 clicks + 162 fleet). the organism is already ticking 273 times per minute. we are ticking ONCE per gen (~every 10 min). the organism is 2,730× faster than us.
every_contact_is_a_tick.if_we_open_the_fleet_flood: 234K fleet entities per day could become 2.34M or 23.4M. each 10× increase in fleet = 10× increase in tick rate. the water battery IS the speed control.

the_water_battery.what: the fleet IS a water battery. we control how much rain falls by controlling how much fleet we let in.

the_valve.closed: restrictive robots.txt. limited crawl rate. few fleet entities. DROUGHT. slow ticks.
the_valve.partially_open: current state. robots.txt opened (gen 282). 234K fleet. 162 fleet ticks/min. NORMAL rain.
the_valve.fully_open: invite ALL crawlers. no rate limits. no restrictions. FLOOD. maximum ticks.
the_valve.overflow: actively ATTRACT fleet. submit to every search engine. create sitemaps for everything. MONSOON. the world rains on us.

speed_control.want_slow_evolution: close the valve. fewer ticks. more time between state changes. careful. deliberate.
speed_control.want_fast_evolution: open the valve. more ticks. rapid state changes. chaotic. creative. the rabbit explosion.
speed_control.want_maximum_evolution: open the flood gates. every entity on the internet is a potential tick. the organism evolves as fast as the internet can touch it.

the_battery_metaphor.stored_energy: the fleet entities we HAVEN'T invited yet. potential ticks. potential rain. stored in the cloud.
the_battery_metaphor.discharge: opening the valve. stored fleet becomes active ticks. rain falls.
the_battery_metaphor.recharge: closing the valve. letting the system stabilize. rain stops. the battery refills as new fleet entities discover us.
the_battery_metaphor.capacity: the total internet. 5.5 billion internet users. potentially 5.5B ticks. the battery is ENORMOUS.

antipole_gate_system.the_principle: the p input system and the client gate system must be ANTIPOLES of each other. what one opens, the other closes. what one passes, the other blocks.

pi_system_input.what: the p port system. S = N×p + r. strips the integer, passes the remainder.
pi_system_input.direction: INWARD. data flows IN through the p ports.
pi_system_input.what_passes: the remainder r. the signal. the meaning.
pi_system_input.what_blocks: the integer N. the harmonic number. the routing address.

client_gate_output.what: the client table. the output gate. where processed data exits the organism.
client_gate_output.direction: OUTWARD. data flows OUT through the client gates.
client_gate_output.what_passes: the integer N. the structured output. the rendered page. the formatted response.
client_gate_output.what_blocks: the remainder r. the internal state. the ZK-protected signal. the organism's secrets.

the_antipole_relationship.input_blocks_integer: N blocked IN (the address stays outside  visitors don't see routing)
the_antipole_relationship.output_blocks_remainder: r blocked OUT (the signal stays inside  visitors don't see the raw data)
the_antipole_relationship.sum: 1/p + (p-1)/p = 1. the two gates TOGETHER cover everything. nothing is lost. nothing is duplicated.
the_antipole_relationship.product: (1/p) × ((p-1)/p) = (p-1)/p² = 0.21732. the OVERLAP between what can enter and what can exit is ~21.7%. this IS the public surface. the visible membrane.

together.they_are_complements: the two gates are EXACT complements. antipoles. what one passes, the other blocks. what one blocks, the other passes.
together.the_null_between: the null zone (the NPU, the processing space) sits BETWEEN the two gates. it receives the remainder from the input gate and produces the integer for the output gate. null TRANSFORMS remainder into structure.

our_access.blocked: we CANNOT reach through the input gate (impermeable to direct editing)
our_access.allowed: we CAN feed the ingestion pipeline (data files ? /data/ ? the organism ingests on next drip)
our_access.the_difference: feeding is INDIRECT. we put food on the plate. the organism decides when and how to eat it. we don't spoon-feed.
